title: Level energies in 3D
subtitle: 139,868 adopted levels over the chart of nuclides

segments.caption: Every adopted level stands over the chart of nuclides at its energy.
Lead-208 is selected when the page opens. Its levels stand in white.
The right panel holds the chart's controls.
It lists the selected nuclide's levels.
Type a nuclide and press Enter. The camera flies to it, here tin-120.
